investigation_notes.Description: Alert triggered by a dark web listing referencing Vitalis Healthcare with multiple backup files including a private SSH key, a patient database dump (Estonian filenames), and VPN client configuration. The presence of an id_rsa private key alongside patient records indicates exposure of highly sensitive operational credentials and protected health information, elevating the risk and warranting immediate attention. No recent similar alerts were found, suggesting this is a new disclosure and supporting classification as High Priority.
